patches.title: Color Song
patches.summary: Colors the Song screen's blocks by what's in them: the same instruments share a color family, and variants get their own shades. Colors are saved per project.

patches.title: Humanize
patches.summary: A Pattern screen button that adds small random timing and volume changes to the selected notes. Ranges are set per project in Config.

patches.title: FX Interpolation
patches.summary: MIDI CC FX and synth Macros ramp smoothly to the next step instead of jumping. Switched on per project in Config.

patches.title: Master FX
patches.summary: Choose the master reverb (Freeverb, Plate, Spring, Shimmer) and delay (Tape, BBD, Gated) per project, played with the usual Master Reverb and Delay knobs.

patches.title: Global Swing
patches.summary: A Swing amount per project that every take and every pattern start uses. Off by default; set in Config.

patches.title: Pad Visualizer
patches.summary: Hold Note, Instrument, FX1 and FX2 while a pattern plays and the pads show drifting smoke with ripples from the notes.

patches.title: Conditional Trigs
patches.summary: Turn a Chance FX past 100 and it becomes a condition on how many times the pattern has played: 1st, !1s (not the first), or 1:2 to 8:8 (the A-th pass of every B), counted per track. Idea from Psygoo's CT6.

patches.title: WAVE and PHASE Synths
patches.summary: Two synths, each taking the place of one synth model per project (Config > Project Settings > Synth Engines), with their own controls and patches. WAVE: wavetables, a super saw, ladder and OB filters. PHASE: Casio CZ-style phase distortion, eight shapes, DCW envelopes, ring and noise mod. Both: two LFOs, a Mod Matrix and a stereo chorus.

patches.title: Legato
patches.summary: A Glide FX (G) on a MIDI or synth (S1-S3) note plays it legato: its note-on goes out before the previous note's note-off, so a mono synth, or a synth slot at Polyphony 1 with Glide Mode Legato, doesn't retrigger its envelopes. Stock firmware ignores G on these notes.

patches.title: Copy Pattern to New
patches.summary: A Pattern screen button (record mode, More twice) that copies the current pattern, unsaved edits and track lengths included, into the next empty pattern, playing or stopped, and stays on the current pattern.

patches.title: Beat Slice Thru
patches.summary: A play mode after Beat Slice in the Sample Playback screen's Play Mode list: slice a sample as in Beat Slice, and each note plays from its slice to the end of the sample instead of stopping at the next slice. With Loop on (More, the 4th button) the note then loops the whole sample until stopped. Saved per project; stock firmware plays such an instrument as Beat Slice.

patches.title: Live Resampling
patches.summary: The Sample Recorder can record with the pattern playing: press Play after Rec, or start the recording with Shift+Rec (after the count-in, if Pre Roll is on). Samples and synths play at the mix levels with delay and reverb; stopping the recording stops the pattern. Recordings go after the loaded samples, so they stay intact. Otherwise the recorder is stock.

patches.title: Variable Track Length
patches.summary: Each track of a pattern can have its own length (Pattern screen, More twice, hold Trk Len and turn the encoder). A shorter track loops its own steps and every track starts again together when the pattern ends; the steps past its length show its loop in grey. Live recording and Conditional Trigs follow the track's own loop. Saved per project; stock firmware plays every track the whole pattern.
